Class GuiController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.ui.GuiController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GuiController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
The main view controller for the gameplay scene. It manages the grid display, next brick previews, score labels, animations, and handles UI updates triggered by the game loop.

      resources - The resources used to localize the root object, or null if unrelated.

      initialSpeed - The starting speed of the game loop.
